description: Defines a class for a chat model node integrating Groq with LlamaIndex, including methods for loading models and initializing the model with credentials and parameters.

classes.name: ChatGroq_LlamaIndex_ChatModels
classes.description: A class representing a chat model node that wraps Groq LLM for LlamaIndex integration, with properties, constructor, loadMethods, and init method.

methods.name: loadModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads available chat models using getModels with MODEL_TYPE.CHAT and 'groqChat'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Groq model instance with parameters from nodeData, including credentials, model name, temperature, and max tokens.
